technique_name: Construct a trivia game about famous athletes.
description: The game would feature a set of multiple choice questions about famous athletes. The questions would be about their careers, achievements, accolades, and personal lives. The game could be played in single-player or multiplayer mode, allowing multiple players to compete against one another and increase the difficulty level over time.
